mechanism: Paroxetine is a potent CYP2D6 inhibitor that may increase systemic timolol concentrations if significant ocular absorption occurs, potentially enhancing beta-blocker effects.
action: Monitor for signs of excessive beta-blockade (bradycardia, hypotension, fatigue); ophthalmic timolol has minimal systemic absorption but caution is warranted in patients on paroxetine with cardiac conditions.
